title: Construction of the normalized dual Koszul comparison
statement: For a commutative ring A, an ideal I, and a finite Koszul-regular sequence f indexed by Fin r with I = (f), there exists an A-linear cochain map from the signed dual Koszul complex [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex] to the restricted B-module wedge^r_B Hom_B(I/I^2,B) in degree r, where B = A/I, satisfying the determinant normalization of [def-sc-koszul-conormal-comparison].

proof.text: Use the conormal basis c_i furnished by lem-sc-koszul-conormal-basis. For s = (-1)^(r*(r-1)/2), construct the top component x |-> s*(x(e_top) mod I)*(c_0^* wedge ... wedge c_(r-1)^*), transporting to the single complex; set the other components to zero.

The incoming dual differential is signed precomposition with Koszul contraction. Evaluating on e_top yields a sum with coefficients f_i, hence lies in I and is killed by the quotient. This verifies the only nontrivial chain-map equation.

For vectors v_i, the ordered top wedge equals det(v)*e_top. Determinant pairing with the dual conormal basis gives det(v) mod I. Multiply by s*(x(e_top) mod I) to obtain the required normalization equation for every x and v.

theorem exists_koszul_conormal_comparison_map
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) :
    ∃ φ : koszulDualComplex A r f ⟶
        (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat A) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) r).obj
          (koszulNormalDeterminant A I r),
      IsKoszulConormalComparison A I r f hf φ
